chain.title: Compressed Iron
chain.desc: Blow up iron ingots or blocks with TNT; about 20% is lost to the blast, and a Pressure Chamber later does the same job losslessly.

chain.title: Pressure Tube
chain.desc: Craft two compressed iron ingots around glass to make the tubes that carry compressed air between every machine.

chain.title: Air Compressor
chain.desc: Craft it from reinforced stone bricks around a furnace and a pressure tube; it burns solid fuel like coal to build your first air pressure.

chain.title: Pressure Chamber
chain.desc: Craft walls from reinforced bricks plus a valve and interface, then build a hollow cube where high pressure crafts compressed iron, PCBs and more without loss.

chain.title: Charging Station
chain.desc: Craft it from bricks, a reinforced stone slab and a pressure tube; piped air charges air canisters, pneumatic tools and armor placed on it.

chain.title: Pneumatic Wrench
chain.desc: Craft compressed iron around an air canister and a lever; the charged wrench rotates and safely dismantles PneumaticCraft machines.

chain.title: Liquid Compressor
chain.desc: Upgrade the Air Compressor with a small tank and leather so it burns liquid fuels, which yield far more air than coal.

chain.title: Seismic Sensor
chain.desc: Place it over bedrock-level terrain and drop TNT nearby; the shockwave readout reveals crude oil lakes hidden underground to pump for fuel.

chain.title: Oil Refinery
chain.desc: Stack a refinery base with output towers, heat it past 100C, and crude oil distills into fractions like diesel, kerosene, gasoline and LPG.

chain.title: Thermopneumatic Processing Plant
chain.desc: Craft it from reinforced stone slabs, a small tank and a pressure tube; heated and pressurized it converts LPG or biodiesel plus coal or charcoal into molten plastic.

chain.title: Plastic Sheet
chain.desc: Cool molten plastic below 0C, classically with a Heat Frame chilled by a Vortex Tube, to solidify it into plastic sheets.

chain.title: Empty PCB
chain.desc: Pressure-chamber a plastic sheet with two redstone torches and three wires at 1.5 bar to produce three empty circuit boards.

chain.title: UV Light Box
chain.desc: Craft redstone lamps, compressed iron, a pressure tube and a PCB blueprint into the box that exposes empty PCBs; longer exposure means higher etching success.

chain.title: Etching Tank
chain.desc: Fill this obsidian-and-glass tank with etching acid (made in the Pressure Chamber) to etch exposed PCBs, with failures recyclable back to empty boards.

chain.title: Unassembled PCB
chain.desc: The successful product of etching an exposed PCB; an Assembly Laser can alternatively make these straight from empty PCBs.

chain.title: Printed Circuit Board
chain.desc: Craft an unassembled PCB with two capacitors and two transistors, both pressure-chambered from plastic, wires, slime and redstone.

chain.title: Assembly Line
chain.desc: Craft the controller from PCBs, compressed iron and a pressure tube, then add a platform, IO units, drill and laser plus a program to automate PCB and tube production.

chain.title: Drone
chain.desc: Craft four turbine rotors around a printed circuit board to build a programmable flying robot.

chain.title: Programmer
chain.desc: Craft it from a PCB, turbine rotors, plastic sheets and black glass panes; puzzle-piece programs written here tell drones to dig, farm, guard or haul.

chain.title: Amadron Tablet
chain.desc: Craft plastic sheets around a GPS Tool and air canister, charge it, and trade with the airborne Amadron delivery network from anywhere.

chain.title: Flux Compressor
chain.desc: Craft it from a PCB, compressed iron gear, turbine rotor, advanced pressure tube, redstone and a blast furnace; it turns Forge Energy directly into high-pressure air.

chain.title: Aerial Interface
chain.desc: The endgame block, crafted around a nether star with ender pearls and pressure chamber walls, links directly to your inventory and feeds your pneumatic armor air remotely.

notes: All 22 ids set-checked against assets/pneumaticcraft/models/item + en_us lang keys of 6.0.23 (309 verified items). Facts confirmed from data/pneumaticcraft/recipes in the jar: explosion_crafting/compressed_iron_ingot.json (20% loss_rate), pressure_chamber/empty_pcb.json (1.5 bar), refinery/oil recipes (373K min temp, diesel/LPG outputs), thermo_plant/plastic_from_biodiesel.json, heat_frame_cooling/plastic.json (max_temp 273K), assembly/unassembled_pcb.json, printed_circuit_board.json, drone.json, flux_compressor.json, aerial_interface.json. Transistor and capacitor exist as items but were folded into the PCB entry to keep the chain milestone-only. No kill: or dim: entries needed. Nothing dropped.
